semantic_fusion.claim: Human intent evidence is a separate typed decision from state/effect authority. A mechanically confirmed voice task can mint a bounded TaskAdmission/HumanIntentDecision, but it does not authorize every downstream mutation. Internal memory mutations may use a different confirmation policy, yet still require deterministic admission and provenance.

Classify every Realtime tool output before dispatch as READ_ONLY_OBSERVATION, EPHEMERAL_SESSION_CONTROL, CANONICAL_INTERNAL_MUTATION, RESEARCH_OR_PROVIDER_REQUEST, TASK_CANDIDATE or EXTERNAL_EFFECT_REQUEST. Every state-changing class binds immutable call/invocation identity, causal input, generation, capability and a class-specific receipt.

Modality-specific front gates may differ, but final external effects converge below voice/text/GRID/plugin surfaces on one deterministic executor-consumed EffectDecision/CapabilityLease and EffectJournal. Repository hooks.json declaration and nonblocking stern bookkeeping are not containment proof.

MemoryCandidate/MemoryAdmission must carry source_event_id or utterance_ref, source actor, content digest, generation, privacy/retention tier, transformation_class and epistemic_class. Retrieval returns those fields and never flattens remembered claims and canonical evidence into one fact-like record. Remembering that X was said is not evidence that X is true.

Realtime research submission is not a read. Treat it as ResearchRequestCandidate requiring explicit HumanIntentDecision plus separate provider/economic/privacy admission before any network/provider execution. Current 9.13 provider authority is HARD_OFF, so this source path receives zero current runtime/provider credit.

F94 source bytes are recoverable from _archiv-phase4, but current package closure is broken because paket.py imports .wegehierarchie. Triggerword 4 must explicitly adapt the archived algorithm or retire the branch and prove no silent degradation; blindly copying archived bytes is not justified.

Historical wache-koenig demonstrates useful one-shot, command-bound pre-execution lease semantics for Bash when actually registered, but its exact runtime registration/order is unproven and it deliberately has zero non-Bash coverage. Preserve the lease pattern, not the regex gate as universal authority.

The first verified accessible repository appearances of stern semantics are shipping/source-availability boundaries, not creation timestamps; host/mirror prehistory remains unresolved and must not be fabricated.
